title: Red Hat Security Advisory: tomcat security update
description: Multiple security vulnerabilities have been identified and fixed in Apache Tomcat as distributed by Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.8. These include security constraint bypass, access control bypass due to an off-by-one error, improper input validation allowing HTTP/2 no-authority bypass of strict SNI validation, improper authentication from principal lookup failure, authentication bypass via replay attack in DIGEST authenticator, unauthorized resource access via FORM authentication bypass, and denial of service via HTTP/2 allocation leak. Red Hat has released updated packages addressing these issues for various architectures and product variants.
